rule_text.name: 702.204a
rule_text.rule: Prophecy is a keyword that represents a static ability linked to a triggered ability. “Prophecy (cost)” means “As you reveal this card from a hidden zone, you may exile it if you haven't exiled any cards with their prophecy ability this turn.” and “When you exile this card with its prophecy ability, you may cast it for (cost) rather than paying its mana cost as long as it remains exiled.”

rule_text.name: 702.204b
rule_text.rule:
When a card with prophecy is revealed, any relevant information about it is retained, but the card is exiled and becomes a new object.
Example Cursed Scroll will know the name of a card with prophecy, but it can't be put into a Fact or Fiction pile or chosen during the resolution of Gifts Ungiven.

rule_text.name: 702.204c
rule_text.rule: A card can't be cast for its prophecy cost if it was exiled by an effect other than its prophecy ability.
